name: Land
description: Land owned by the company. Not depreciated.

name: Buildings
description: Offices, warehouses, factories and other buildings owned by the company.

name: Plant and Machinery
description: Production machinery, generators, industrial and heavy equipment.

name: Motor Vehicles
description: Cars, pick-ups, trucks, vans and motorbikes used for the business.

name: Furniture and Fittings
description: Office furniture, fixtures, air conditioners and office equipment.

name: Computer and IT Equipment
description: Laptops, desktops, servers, printers, network and phone equipment.

name: Capital Work in Progress
description: Assets under construction or installation, not yet in use. Not depreciated: transfer to the final asset account when put into service.

name: Right-of-Use Assets
description: Leased assets recognised under the lease standard (offices, warehouses, vehicles). Duration depends on each lease term.

name: Accumulated Depreciation - Computer and IT Equipment
Intangible Assets - Software
description: Software bought for the business (ERP, accounting, CRM) and operating system licences.

name: Intangible Assets - Licences and Other
description: Licences, permits, trademarks, patents and other intangible rights.
